column1: # A request's id (`rid`, the name of <sub>/requests/<rid> and of its mark <sub>/commands/<rid>): one table for the
# course (Source/tests/testdata/rid.tsv) and the product (testdata/rid.tsv at its root), byte for byte. Owner:
# «Паритет»; rule: «Архитектор», 2026-10-06, after the fourteenth review (the course counted characters and answered
# THE RULE: at most 200 BYTES of UTF-8, not empty, not . or ..; no / \ " ' and no character of Unicode's Cc, Zl or Zp
# (controls, U+0085, U+2028, U+2029). Refused at the door with a 400; on the worker's path as RequestRefused,
# Columns, tab-separated; a line that begins with '#' and an empty line are no row:
#   rid      the id as a JSON string; a character of Cc, Zl or Zp is written escaped (\u0085, \u2028), every other
